```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(highcharter)
library(readr)

source(here::here("R", "model-timeline.R"))

source_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbkunst/motorsport-legends/",
  "main/data/cars/ferrari_past_models_enriched.csv"
)

brand <- list(
  name = "Ferrari",
  initial_model = "F40",
  accent = "#e10600",
  font_family = "IBM Plex Sans",
  point_spacing = 0.14,
  stack_span = 0.90,
  tooltip_image_transform = function(url) {
    sub("\\?.*$", "?width=320&height=180", url)
  },
  category_labels = c(
    "Sports-racing prototypes" = "Sports prototypes",
    "Mid-engined sports car" = "Mid‑engine sports",
    "Front-engined V12 two-seat GT" = "Front V12 two‑seat",
    "Competition derivatives" = "Competition",
    "Front-engined V12 2+2 GT" = "Front V12 2+2",
    "Mid-engined 2+2 GT" = "Mid‑engine 2+2",
    "Front-engined V8 GT" = "Front V8 GT",
    "Limited-series halo" = "Halo series",
    "Hybrid supercar" = "Hybrid supercar",
    "Mid-engined 12-cylinder supercar" = "Mid‑engine V12",
    "Icona limited series" = "Icona series"
  )
)

source_data <- read_csv(source_url, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(.data$source_origin == "ferrari_past_models_scraper")

ferrari_records <- source_data |>
  transmute(
    Model = model_timeline_record_link(.data$model, .data$url),
    Photo = model_timeline_record_photo(
      .data$image_url,
      brand$tooltip_image_transform(.data$image_url)
    ),
    Year = .data$source_year,
    Category = .data$source_category,
    Engine = .data$engine,
    `Displacement (cc)` = .data$displacement_cc,
    `Power (cv)` = .data$max_power_cv,
    `Power rpm` = .data$rpm_max_power,
    `Top speed (km/h)` = .data$top_speed_kmh,
    `Engine position` = .data$engine_position,
    `Engine orientation` = .data$engine_orientation,
    `Engine angle (deg)` = .data$engine_angle_deg,
    `Compression ratio` = .data$compression_ratio,
    `Bore (mm)` = .data$bore_mm,
    `Stroke (mm)` = .data$stroke_mm,
    `Weight (kg)` = .data$weight_kg,
    `Wheelbase (mm)` = .data$wheelbase_mm,
    `Length (mm)` = .data$length_mm,
    `Width (mm)` = .data$width_mm,
    `Height (mm)` = .data$height_mm,
    Description = .data$description
  )

cars <- model_timeline_adapt(
  source_data,
  mapping = list(
    model = "model",
    year = "start_year",
    category = "main_family",
    description = "description",
    image_url = "image_url",
    official_url = "url"
  ),
  details = c(
    "Engine" = "engine",
    "Displacement (cc)" = "displacement_cc",
    "Power (cv)" = "max_power_cv",
    "Top speed (km/h)" = "top_speed_kmh",
    "Weight (kg)" = "weight_kg"
  )
)
```

::: {.model-timeline-chart aria-label="Interactive timeline of Ferrari models by year and category"}

```{r}
#| label: ferrari-timeline

model_timeline_chart(
  cars,
  initial_model = brand$initial_model,
  brand = brand$name,
  accent = brand$accent,
  font_family = brand$font_family,
  source_url = source_url,
  category_labels = brand$category_labels,
  tooltip_image_transform = brand$tooltip_image_transform,
  point_spacing = brand$point_spacing,
  stack_span = brand$stack_span
)
```

  visible_columns = c(
    "Model", "Photo", "Year", "Category", "Engine",
    "Displacement (cc)", "Power (cv)", "Top speed (km/h)"
  )
)
